issue.title: Record the display-only boundary for private provider session logs
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1oi.1 note #1, sase-1oi.2 note #2, and sase-1oi.3 note #2. The approved plan plan:202610/muse_commentary_live_reply.md selected decision_record=no without human review. The landed Muse tail reads private session logs strictly for live display, while returned content, salvage, control flow, and completion remain authoritative stdout/host behavior. Small scope: one precisely specified new decision strand and regenerated memory projections after authorization; no runtime change.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a decision strand stating that private provider session logs may feed display-only fail-soft surfaces, never control flow, returned content, or completion. Explain alternatives (synthetic tool breadcrumbs, prompting narration, muse serve/MSP, moving parsing to core), format-drift cost, and reopening when muse exec --json exports phase or parsing moves to sase_core. Link [[decisions/adapters-normalize-harnesses]] and republish memory. This records the accepted implementation boundary; it does not alter that existing decision.
